scripts.name: RSI Probability Matrix [ChartPrime]
scripts.author: ChartPrime
scripts.input_contract: Finite repository OHLC with unique increasing index; caller supplies only completed bars. No volume, lower-timeframe or higher-timeframe input required.
scripts.state_contract: Resolve old position before source flat-state entry gate; target checked before stop; same-bar re-entry allowed; entry-bar extrema never resolve newly opened position; RSI rounded into0–100 bins; no expiry.
scripts.statistics_contract: Counts update only on resolution and are snapshotted after each observed completed bar. Entry prior counts include an older trade resolved on the same bar. Default exposes aggregate/current-bucket counts; include_matrix exposes all404 causal count-series. No final-chart backfill.
scripts.ambiguity_contract: Source-reference target-first outcome preserved with explicit ambiguous_resolution flag. These optimistic counters are not corrected option-ledger outcomes or validated strategy evidence.
scripts.mechanical_proposal_rule: Enter on source accepted one-position-gated RSI/SMA signals. Exit flags identify its target/stop reference resolution bars. The options execution/accounting layer remains authoritative.
scripts.port_scope: RSI,SMA,ATR,raw conditions,source entry conditions,accepted entries,reference target/stop states,resolved counts and causal matrix snapshots. Plot graphics and dashboard rendering omitted.
